title: The questions format, version 1
description: A work item's questions and their answers: the file of a version of the artifact type questions, one document per work item. A run adds, withdraws or reopens questions; the control plane writes the answers. Each question's id is unique in the document, which a JSON Schema cannot check. The file is at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes), the type's size limit, which a JSON Schema cannot check either. No object has a member this schema does not define.

questions.description: Every question of the work item, in the order they were asked.

question.description: One question. answer is present exactly when state is answered.

id.description: The question's id, unique in the document: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as q1.

question.description: The question, plain text on one line: one sentence, 1 to 500 characters.

context.description: What a person needs to know to answer, as Markdown: absent when the question needs none.

options.description: The answers a member can pick, 0 to 10: empty when the run lists no option and the member writes the answer.

state.description: open until a member answers the question, answered once a member answered it, withdrawn once a run withdrew it.

asked.description: The run that added the question, and when.

answer.description: The member's answer, which the control plane writes.

follows.description: The ids of earlier questions in the document that this question follows from: absent or empty when it follows from none.

history.description: The earlier answers of the question, oldest first: each one ended when a run reopened the question.

items.description: An earlier answer: the members of an answer, and reopened.

reopened.description: The run that reopened the question, and when.

option.description: An answer a member can pick.

explanation.description: A short explanation of the option, plain text.

answer.description: A member's answer to a question: an option the member chose, or null and a note. note is required when option is null.

option.description: The title of the option the member chose, or null when the member wrote the answer in note. The title is one of the question's option titles, which a JSON Schema cannot check.

note.description: Added detail on the chosen option, or the member's answer when option is null, as Markdown.

option_title.description: An option's title, plain text, 1 to 200 characters.

member.description: A member of the control plane.

name.description: The name the control plane shows for the member, 1 to 160 characters on one line.

id.description: A question's id: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

time.description: RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, ending Z: hours 00 to 23, minutes and seconds 00 to 59, so never a leap second.

text.description: Text that may span lines. Tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters: it has none of U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

line.description: Text on one line: text as $defs text defines it, with no control character at all, so no tab, line feed or carriage return.

short_text.description: A short text, such as an option's explanation or a note: 1 to 2000 characters.
